policy: Supplied fantasy prospect ranking is the dominant value anchor for all listed prospects, including debuted players. This is an explicit dynasty valuation policy, not a claim that ordinal rankings establish market prices or expected category production.
identity: Exact supplied Fantrax ID joins only. Retain source membership independently of MLB debut and eligibility. Keep unmatched and unmodeled IDs unavailable; preserve unsupported players outside the supplied list.
anchor: Fit a decreasing isotonic mapping from supplied ranks to deployed neutral values of matched, non-debuted, pure-prospect assets. This preserves the existing calculator scale rather than inventing price premiums. All rookies are excluded from anchor fitting. Do not describe this internal-scale fit as historical performance validation.
deviation: Use per-unit talent contribution at the frozen historical reference workload; never use partial-season volume as the model's rank signal. Map its empirical historical same-role percentile to a rank within the corresponding supplied hitter/pitcher population. Combine source and model in log-rank space with model weight .5*career_exposure/(career_exposure+K). This guarantees source weight greater than50% while membership is active. Half is a policy dominance constraint, not a fitted optimum.
strengths: Sensitivity grid K_H=[150,300,600,1200], K_P=[42.5,85,170,340]. Existing600PA/170IP is the reference comparator, not preclaimed best. Cap deviations at the immediately adjacent supplied source tiers. Tiers express source uncertainty; this bound is a disclosed policy choice.
pitchers: Do not use saves/holds or relief QA3 as prospect talent signals. Require known role and at least ten verified appearances before a pitcher model deviation. A short relief debut cannot establish a future bullpen assignment. Supported pitching ratios/strikeouts remain component-based.
no_duplicate_adjustments: Do not reapply age, ETA, injury or level penalties already reflected in supplied ranking. No new MiLB rate translations or medical availability estimates without validated independent inputs. Current source publication date is unknown; same-snapshot model disagreement is not independent Bayesian updating.
historical: Use independently dated preserved FanGraphs rankings only, not the2026 upload. Restrict to ranks at or before first MLB season, max two-year source age, first or second positive MLB season, career<=600PA or170IP, origins>=2013 and three future seasons complete through2025. Development2013-2015, later2016-2022. Predictors use only origin-or-earlier observations. Report chronological rank correlation and within-origin pair accuracy against three-year discounted realized contribution, with zero absent seasons. Preserve subtype and sparse sub250PA limitations. Previously inspected sample is not a fresh independent holdout; different-provider historical ranking is not validation of the supplied fantasy list.
recommendation: Prefer a reference strength only if later ranking discrimination improves without worse small-debut performance and sample support is adequate. Otherwise deliver sensitivities and limits without claiming an optimal strength or adopting production.
continuity: Explicit zero-to-positive exposure checks, no eligibility switch at firstPA or firstIP. Compare source-only anchor, ranking-led adjustments and existing deployed values. Keep contribution forecasts distinct from ranking-policy values, and leave production unchanged during research.
talent_signal: H: frozen category-normalized HR, SB, AVG-impact, OPS-impact at reference PA; omit R/RBI context and known RBI-rate bias. P: frozen category-normalized ER,K,KBB-impact,WHIP-impact at reference IP; omit SV,HLD,QA3 opportunity. Use corrected observed-role calibration samples. No changes to underlying projected rates.
historical_rank_signal: Historical FG top100 model rank is1+99*(1-talent_percentile), because the preserved ranking files are incomplete and do not support reconstruction of a full family order. This differs from the current full500-source family mapping and is only a proxy diagnostic.
